title: Yorker In The Blockhole (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 136bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son. The yorker.
Full pitched, on the boot, at the blockhole
You cannot play that

[Verse 1]
Release the ball from high in the arc
Aim for the base of the stumps, make your mark
Full length delivery, lands at the feet
Yorker at the blockhole, batter is beat

Blockhole is the base of the front foot line
Aim eighteen to twenty metres down and fine
No room to swing, bat is jammed to the ground
Yorker at the blockhole, no shot found

[Pre-Chorus]
Full release high, aim at the base
Blockhole at the crease, pinned in place
Eighteen to twenty metres on the full
Yorker at the blockhole, that is the pull

[Chorus]
Yorker in the blockhole, base of the stumps
Full pitch delivery, land at the clumps
No room to play, bat jams to the ground
Yorker in the blockhole, wicket found

[Verse 2]
In death overs the yorker is the key
Fuller than full, right at the feet
Change of pace yorker, ten ks slower through
Yorker in the blockhole, that is the view

[Bridge]
Bluey: YORKER AT THE BLOCKHOLE, CLEAN BOWLED, WHAT A DELIVERY
Trevor: A well-directed yorker reduces the batters effective shot zone by ninety-two percent
Chas: Son, aim at the bootlace. Not the stump. The bootlace. That is the target.

[Chorus]
Yorker in the blockhole, base of the stumps
Full pitch delivery, land at the clumps
No room to play, bat jams to the ground
Yorker in the blockhole, wicket found

[Outro]
Aim at the bootlace son
Not the stump
The bootlace
Thats my boy
